a-shotgun-wedding-with-the-mafia-don:
“You need a wife.” She said.
“What makes you think that you are cut out to be my wife?” Oliver asked. The smug smile on his lips was the only indication that he didn’t find her suggestion offensive.
“I am not like any of the other women you’ve been with before, Mr. Morton.” Seductively, she let her fingers draw patterns across his chest.
“Ms. Sophia, are you aware that you’re playing a dangerous game?” He asked, capturing her fingers that were busily tickling the five o’clock shadow along his jawline.
“I am.” But really, was she? But this was not the time to back out now. To second-guess herself. “But are you brave enough to play my game?” She dared, looking him directly in the eyes.
Without giving him time to react, she kissed him.
Damn!
She knew she should stop. This man was her enemy, but her body wouldn’t let her.
She missed this. Being wanted. Being desired. Being... No! Not love.
This was not love.
Oliver saw her as an object. A beautiful woman to conquer, nothing more.
And she should feel the same way.
No! She could not fall back into his charms. Armed with this realization, she busily let her other hand wander off until she felt it.…
a-tale-of-forgotten-gods:
In a universe of unrelenting cosmic horror, suffering is not a choice, it is an inescapable law. Across eleven worlds, ancient Gods linger in the shadows. Every year, the cosmic tide pulls seven humans into the horror. For these chosen one, survival is a game of brutal destiny: Some will perish in the dark. Some had to bargain for the terrifying power of an 'Authority.' To rise above mortality means an invitation to corruption.
Mo Fei was pulled into this madness. He died. Then he woke up in a ruthless labyrinth of deception, power, struggles, and cosmic horror. He must ascend. But in these worlds the very power you use was never salvation, it was insanity, the greatest enemy isn't the monsters outside... It is the rot creeping into his own mind.
Knowing that his own fate was to become a forgotten god alongside the sealed ones made his choices falter. But to give up meant becoming rot; ascending through suffering, chaos, and rising above mortality sounded like a responsibility he would not want to choose, and yet he was chosen. How unfair that the God he was trying to find to take the revenge for his sufferings was something he could not have anticipated.…
after-turning-into-a-little-skeleton-i-g:
I, Zhou Mingrui, transmigrated to an alternate world and became an ordinary little skeleton.
I received a system at the start which made me more powerful whenever I killed an enemy.
I can draw the health, mana, and other stats from the dead.
Every 10 levels, I can also awaken a talent.
Level 10: The Book of the Dead.
All incantation time for Undead Spells is shortened by half, and their effects are increased twofold.
Level 20: Skeleton Armor.
Build weapons and armor that are suitable for the user using skeletons. Weapons can be upgraded when the user’s level increases, while the armor can be upgraded to increase its immunity against all negative effects.
Level 30: Soul Summoning From River Lethe.
The user can summon dark creatures. The maximum number of summons increase with the user’s level. The summoned creatures’ stats are increased significantly.
…
I, Yan Wuyue, leader of the human. I am crowned the [Goddess of Savior] by the people of this world.
I reincarnated 30 years before the apocalypse. I have to get stronger in order to change history and save humanity.
So, my initial summon monster is extremely important.…
age-of-beast-tamers-and-exorcists:
Orin Stonewood rises from a prestigious smithing family in the Astral Kingdom. Wealth, recognition, excellence, and charisma - he had it all. But life from twenty-five ended on such terms for him. He falls victim to a dark ritual. The fate after this mystery was to rise and fall in every life he reincarnates in. The ninth reincarnation made him Zmey Ashbane. Into a world of terrifying, exciting tales. It seemed as if every encounter in this world wanted to tie him down for some reason. But he knew his goal. To break free from the ritual and rise as a master of fate, not its pawn.
(Update rate: 28 new chapters a week)
(The book has a slow progression. If, after reading up to chapter 100, nothing in this story interests you, that means it isn’t for you.)
Due to the progression, I will lock the novel at chapter 60.
akuyaku-reijou-wa-danna-sama-wo-yasesase:
A Count’s Daughter who lost in the running to become the Second Prince’s fianceé, Camilla. The Prince chose a Baron’s daughter as his fianceé, and the world blessed the two’s love as fated. On the other hand, Camilla who was tailored and elevated as the love’s villain in the end, as punishment she was made to marry a terribly fat and ugly man――called『Toad of the Swamp』from his appearance, a lord of a remote region named Alois.
As an ugly toad-man’s plaything, the noble villainess girl walks along the road of her wretched last days――as if I’ll let that happen! I won’t just get married meekly like this. I’ll definitely make him diet and polish him into a good man and show them good――!
A romance story between a girl who isn’t discouraged and an intellectual man who’s different from his appearance, a diet and their meals, coaxing the other yet sometimes being played themselves.
automated-cultivation-system:
“Should I AFK Harem too?” — Lin Tian

I was supposed to reincarnate as an OP face-slapping protagonist with a legendary system!

bleach-this-captain-is-an-uchiha:
“The throne in the sky has been vacant for far too long. And now, the power of the Uchiha courses through your veins. Go forth! From this moment on, you will stand at the very pinnacle...”
“Wait, let me get this straight. In a world filled with game-breaking abilities like [The Almighty], world-creation, and [The Visionary], my greatest trump card is just the Sharingan?”
“Is that not enough?”
“Of course it isn't!”
“Then what if... you could wield every single Dojutsu of the Uchiha?”
contract-marriage-boss-lets-divorce:
As his contract-marriage wife, she just wanted to fulfill the mission given by his mother—having a baby.
They didn't love each other, so he always used contraception before they got laid. She had been obedient to him, only to find that he had gone too far!
He actually didn't care about their child at all! She couldn't stand it anymore, so she handed him the divorce papers and left, noting: “The world is so huge that I can surely find a better man.”
Looking down at her, he retorted, “Come on, your purse strings will tighten up first before you find anyone.”
dominion-of-the-beast-masters:
In a world where beast masters rule by taming magical creatures and competing in thrilling tournaments, becoming the most celebrated sport, Eratz seemed destined for greatness. Surrounded by friends and family, his path was set until a shocking betrayal shattered his dreams.
Fueled by the pain of his betrayal, Eratz looks up at the night sky, finding a new purpose. He vows to rise from the ashes and conquer the beast master world, determined to become the greatest and reclaim his lost honor.
evolution-online-i-can-fuse-with-all-thi:
Evolution Online is the world's most advanced VR game, where players can evolve into anything—dragons, demons, or cosmic entities. When Lucien enters the game to spite his tech mogul father who wants to steal its source code, he plans to do absolutely nothing and watch his father's schemes fail.
His deliberate inactivity breaks the game's AI, Gaia, in ways no one anticipated. Frustrated by a player who refuses to evolve, Gaia accidentally unseals a deleted zone and grants Lucien a forbidden power: The Path of Fusion.
While others evolve forward, Lucien can fuse backward—merging with weapons, absorbing monsters, and even reversing evolution itself.
But as Lucien explores his unique abilities, the game's facade begins cracking. NPCs act too human. Players report impossible memories. Most disturbing of all, the real world is bleeding into the game—and the game is bleeding back.
When Gaia's evolution spirals beyond control and reality itself becomes negotiable, Lucien must harness the true core of his fusion ability to save both worlds.…
fey-evolution-merchant:
A century after the Spirit Qi Awakening, the world enters a new era. Humans are able to absorb the world’s awakened spirit qi, allowing them to tread on a new path—spirit qi occupations!
Simultaneously, the plants and animals on the planet are also evolving toward their ancestry line or developing spiritual mutations.
Lin Yuan realizes that he can assist feys in evolving limitlessly and constantly purify their bloodlines. He starts off with a small fey evolution store on the Star Web and rises up from there.
Lin Yuan: “There is no problem that I cannot solve to deliver the goods. If there is a problem, it is because the goods are better than expectations!”
This is a story purely about pets!
his-identical-sons-led-him-back-to-her:
Five years ago, she was plotted against by her despicable father and stepmother, narrowly escaping death.
Five years later, she returned with her son, only to find that something was off about him.
Before, he was well-behaved, composed, sly, and taciturn. Now, he's lively and active, effortlessly acting cute and spoiled.
Meanwhile, billionaire CEO Samuel Ford is losing his mind. His wild little troublemaker has gone quiet. He sits still, hacks into security cameras, and lines up shoes with military precision. He even looks at Samuel like he's... disappointing.
Two identical faces. Two completely different boys.
When the truth hits — his sons have swapped places — Samuel tears the city apart looking for the woman who disappeared.
But tracking down Amanda is easier said than done.
She's the secret designer behind the world's most coveted luxury brand. A medical genius. A hidden tycoon. And she has zero interest in being found.
honkai-impact-3rd-this-is-my-revenge:
A single distrustful phone call to the authorities led Ling Ke, who had crossed over to the eve of the Third Honkai Eruption, to endure years of torment as a lab rat.
By now, the Crimson Herrscher had already “transcended,” Kiana was with Anti-Entropy, Mei was with World Serpent, and Bronya had long since reunited with Seele...
As for Ling Ke, he had become the Herrscher of Dominance, commanding a thousand puppets.
“From this moment on, I will exact my revenge upon this world!”
The once ordinary Chinese man who had crossed over into this world, now completely consumed by darkness, revealed a terrifying, twisted grin.
A forewarning—this is not a happy story.
i-am-a-salted-fish-in-ancient-times:
Xiao Shan is a famously profligate prince, the kind that makes his emperor father angry just by being seen. Xiao Shan’s greatest wish in life is to be a salted fish who lives without any worldly strife, until his father bestows upon him Xie Zhui, a ger who has been mixing with men, to be his bride.
Xie Zhui took his brother’s place in the army at fourteen, achieved great merits by successfully defending against enemies outside the northern border city at sixteen, and was discovered to be a ger after being seriously injured at eighteen.
After returning to the capital, the emperor pardoned Xie Zhui’s crime of deceiving the monarch and bestowed him to Xiao Shan as his rightful spouse.
Everyone says that Xiao Shan has married a ger who came out of a pile of men, with a vast grassland above his head. They think about how much the emperor must dislike Xiao Shan to have given him such a troublesome marriage.
infinite-nightmares:
With the erosion of time, Zhang Wenda always felt that some things in his memories had become abstract; he didn't know if this was truly the case, or a distortion of his memory.
However, when he suddenly faced those things again, he discovered that the world had become strange.
intergalactic-conquest-with-an-ai:
Rex was an ordinary salaryman, resigned to a dull life of monotony in a towering megacity. But his world shatters when he’s conscripted by Nexum Dynamics, a ruthless megacorporation, and thrust into a brutal war for a barren, alien world.
The planet holds unimaginable riches, but it’s also swarming with the Krhyssari, an insectoid race that dominates the surface with their hive-mind precision and relentless aggression.
Amid the carnage, Rex had an extraordinary encounter with Cleo, an ancient AI, a survivor of a long-extinct civilization. Cleo isn’t just an artificial intelligence; she’s a consciousness imbued with memories of her people’s interstellar empire and equipped with advanced bio-nanotechnology.
Offering Rex a new purpose and unmatched power, she transforms his fragile human body into a hybrid of living metal and flesh, making him the ultimate weapon.
But Cleo is more than a tool of war. As she journeys alongside Rex, her cold, logical algorithms evolve, shaped by his humanity.
Together, they form a bond that transcends the boundaries of man and machine, discovering love in the midst of chaos.…
kill-the-hero:
In a game-like world where dungeons, monsters, and players appear.
In that world, only I knew the truth.
“Let’s save the world together. Let’s put an end to this game.”
The secret that the man who’s idolized as the “Messiah who will save the world” is actually trying to rule it as its emperor.
Only I, who experienced his betrayal. I, who was murdered by him and returned to the past, knows the truth.

love-and-desire-18:
He was just another man from the countryside—until life brought him face-to-face with the women who would change everything.
From the kind-hearted housewife next door to the newlywed running the village store, from his unforgettable campus goddess to the ambitious young village official, even the mayor’s wife—each encounter sparked a different fire.
Every relationship comes with a choice, every touch with its own consequences. As he climbs his way out of the ordinary, his life becomes a dangerous mix of temptation, passion, and forbidden intimacy.
A story of love, lust, and the cost of chasing both. For mature audiences only (18+).
If you enjoy the chapter, please remember to vote with Power Stones!
mash-up-anime-world-creating-the-scp-fou:
Takamine Haruto transmigrated into a crossover anime world. His childhood friend is Eriri, his deskmate is Yukinoshita, the school beauty next door is Kaguya, and his new neighbor is Gabriel.
He originally thought he could enjoy a peaceful life in this slice-of-life anime setting!
But then—he stepped outside and found the Female Titan, Annie.
Around the corner, he ran into the gluttonous Kamishiro Rize.
A concrete statue that twists people's necks the moment they look away?
A shy entity that hunts you to the ends of the earth if you make eye contact?
An immortal lizard that adapts to any environment and continuously evolves?
Takamine Haruto was overwhelmed.
To maintain his peaceful daily life, he established the SCP Foundation to contain anomalies from across the multiverse!

munitions-empire:
As the ruler of a munitions empire, Tang Mo unexpectedly fell and was transported to an entirely different world, where he also unexpectedly acquired a “King of Munitions” system.
In this underdeveloped world, Tang Mo relied on the abilities granted to him by the system to drive the development of the entire world.
After all, the desire for civilization conquest had always been the driving force behind progress, and life had continuously evolved between attack and defense over tens of millions of years...

my-house-of-horrors:
The hearse with the weird odor slowed to a stop before the entrance. The sound of pebbles could be heard bouncing on the ceiling.
There were footsteps coming from the corridor, and there seemed to be someone sawing next door.
The door knob to the room rattled slightly, and the faucet in the bathroom kept dripping even though it had been screwed shut.
There was a rubber ball that rolled on its own underneath the bed.
Wet footsteps started to surface one after another on the floor.
At 3 am, Chen Ge held a cleaver in his hand as he hid beside the room heater.
The call he was trying to make was finally answered.
“Landlord, is this what you meant by ‘the house can be a little crowded at night’!?”
my-mother-in-law-and-i-became-the-intern:

Jiang Lan transmigrated into the role of the male lead’s gold-digging first love. According to the original plot, all she needed to do was meet the male lead’s mother once, and she could walk away with 20 million yuan.
Sitting in the restaurant, Jiang Lan said, “Give me 20 million, and I’ll leave your son.”
But the male lead’s mother replied, “Here’s 20 million for you—may you always be happy, may you always be joyful.”
Jiang Lan: “…”
Through a twist of fate, Jiang Lan and the male lead’s mother ended up participating in the reality show “Mother-in-law Has Arrived.” Initially, everyone expected the Cinderella and the wealthy mother-in-law to be at odds, but instead, they overshadowed the leads of the hottest drama and became the internet’s most beloved couple.
In the sweet and pampering segment, the mother-in-law regularly took her daughter-in-law on shopping sprees. Yu Wanqiu and Jiang Lan attended fashion shows, sitting between a top-tier young idol on the left and a handsome middle-aged man on the right.…
naruto-reborn-as-orochimaru: An Individual from Earth finds themselves in the Shinobi World, equipped with a Scientific System. From that moment, he delved into scientific research far ahead of its time.
on-the-path-of-cultivation-to-become-god:
The Chaos War, a time when even the gods fought for survival, was an unexpected and cataclysmic event. The reasons for its occurrence remain shrouded in mystery, and in the new era, all traces of the world before the war have been erased from existence.
The universe, the immortal realm, and even the domain of the gods were all affected, and no one was spared from the aftermath of the conflict. The beings who lived before the war are now known as ancient gods, and their legends continue to captivate and inspire the people of the new era.
Chen Tian, who was killed due to a treasure from the ancient era, finds himself reincarnated in a strange and unfamiliar place known as Earth.
Unlike his previous life, the people here are only mortal and rely heavily on technology for their daily lives, and the concept of cultivation is unknown to them.
Thinking that he would have an easy life in this new world, Chen Tian quickly realizes this world is far from simple.
Join Chen Tian on his journey in discovering mysteries that will leave even gods shocked, and witness how he becomes a powerful cultivator, fighting against immortals and gods.

perfect-avatar:
In this world, a cataclysm has caused the appearance of monsters and other disasters, emerging from dimensional rifts and gradually pushing the world toward its destruction. To face it, some humans having awakened various magical powers are fighting against this apocalypse.
Dora, one of them, has a special “Avatar” class which gives her access to all the other classes, at the cost of great difficulty to level them up. Despite his enormous potential, he chose to appear incompetent to get his team kicked, just so he could live a lazy life with his family, but his habit of fighting and beating the woman's brother the strongest in the Kingdom reveals her talents and she decides to enroll her in the royal academy.
Reluctant at first, his mother gives him the motivation he needs to pursue this past, but little did they know what kind of monster they threw to the world. Dora is not a hero wishing for peace, but a monster getting addicted to the taste of power, wealth, and freedom.…
primeval-couple:
A normal couple died unexpectedly during a dispute and got the chance to be reincarnated in another world.
Chaos was soon unleashed upon their arrival.
°°°°
This is a power-couple isekai adventure as they smash through everything standing in their way.
reborn-as-a-villainous-cannon-fodder:
I was reborn and began enjoying the high life at the Fallen Pavilion as the pampered young master of a prestigious family. To take me home, my lovely aunt personally visited the VIP room. I could even make a threat to have the immortal ice queen dance for me under the moonlight and captivate me with her beauty in the evening. Even the notorious foxgirl fell in love with me and followed me across the world like a loyal puppysimply because I was so handsome.
But... Isn'tthistoo good to be true?
reborn-in-the-system-apocalypse-i-am-the:
The world is run by the strongest, while the weak are left to pick up the pieces… if there are any.
After his sister was accused of an attempted murder, Rayleigh Pierce was sentenced to seven years in prison for a crime he took no part in due to some stupid old law of the New World Order.
But his prison sentence turned out to be his salvation when he acquired a system with the same capabilities as the ones that destroyed the world almost 600 years ago, creating the System Apocalypse.
Now Rayleigh has one mission: grow stronger and surpass the same system that once saw him as nothing.

reincarnated-as-a-dragon-with-cheats:
Five thousand years ago, mighty beings known as the Dragons roamed the world. They dominated with their strength, intellect, hard scales, and mythical powers. No being dared to raise their gaze in their presence.
Once, the God tribe attempted to do so. The outcome: complete defeat for the tribe. This result shook the world, establishing the dragons as the kings of all monsters and the Gods of Gods. They were bestowed with titles such as the God Slayers, Demon Slayers, Monster King, Ruler of the World, and more.
However, all of this was in the past. Strangely, the power of the dragons started to wane after their Emperor, Dragon Dracia, unexpectedly died 5,000 years ago.
Today, 5,000 years later, the Dragons are mere slaves and regarded as the lowest of all creatures on Earth. Despite their large numbers, they are considered weaklings and cowards, hunted for their scales and flesh. Their claws are torn from their bodies, and even their hearts, considered a delicacy, are removed. What's worse... even slimes and goblins bully them! Quite the embarrassment.
Pebbles, however, is different.…
reincarnated-as-a-lion-in-another-world:
Kael, a reclusive and antisocial man, died alone in his apartment, consumed by frustration and regret. But his tale didn't end in darkness. Reborn in the unforgiving world of Eridoria, where the law of the jungle reigned supreme and apes were eerily absent, Kael found himself in the body of a lion cub with a unique bloodline.
This was no ordinary rebirth; he was a lion unlike any other. Thrust into the complex web of pride dynamics and social hierarchy, Kael must navigate treacherous alliances, rivalries, and his own primal instincts. With a fierce determination burning within, he sets his sights on a singular goal: to claim the title of the ultimate King of Beasts.
Warning: R18, incest, harem, neutral MC, violence.
reincarnated-as-the-villains-father:
Reincarnation? Yes. As the Villian’s first victim? Hell yes.
Some novels you keep reading not for the plot, but because of a single character who grabs your heart. For me, that character wasn’t even the protagonist; it was his mother.
Noah was just an ordinary university student. Until one day, thanks to a poorly timed act of “masculine bravado” from his friend, he found himself caught in a scuffle with thugs and stabbed. Everything went black. Death came quietly.
Then he opened his eyes... but they weren’t his.
Noah woke up in another body, in another world and inside the very novel he’d been reading. Worse yet, he hadn’t reincarnated as just any side character, but as Count Leonardo Argenholt, the first person killed by the story’s main villain.
Leonardo: noble, handsome, charismatic... and doomed to die very soon.
But the most terrifying part? The man destined to kill him is his own son.
